```sql
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_container = 'WRAP CAN' THEN l.l_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS wrap_can_revenue,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01'
      AND l.l_shipdate <= '1996-12-31'
      AND p.p_container = 'WRAP CAN'
    GROUP BY c.n_name
),
total_revenues AS (
    SELECT 
        c.n_name AS nation_name,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01'
      AND l.l_shipdate <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY c.n_name
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(sp.nation_name, tr.nation_name) AS nation_name,
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(sp.wrap_can_revenue, 0) + COALESCE(tr.total_revenue, 0) > 0 
            THEN (COALESCE(sp.wrap_can_revenue, 0) * 100.0) / (COALESCE(sp.wrap_can_revenue, 0) + COALESCE(tr.total_revenue, 0))
            ELSE 0
        END, 
        2
    ) AS wrap_can_percentage
FROM ship_percentages sp
FULL OUTER JOIN total_revenues tr ON sp.nation_name = tr.nation_name
WHERE sp.nation_name IS NOT NULL OR tr.nation_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY wrap_can_percentage DESC, nation_name ASC;
```
